title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by $$y=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_1}^2+\theta_2 \sqrt{x_2}$$. Here, $$y$$ is the attendance rate, $$x_1$$ is $$dist_{from,bell}$$, and $$x_2$$ is $$section_{no}$$.

title: Effect of Removing the Intercept
text: Removing the intercept $$\theta_0$$ means the model will pass through the origin. This can lead to a higher bias if the true relationship does not pass through the origin.

title: Impact on Bias
text: Consider how removing the intercept affects the flexibility of the model. Does it allow the model to fit the data better or worse?

title: Evaluating the Suggestion
text: Does removing the intercept reduce the model's ability to fit the data accurately?
